## About
We're a locally owned and operated mechanic shop in the North Austin area. Transmissions are our specialty, and we handle general auto repair, diesel work, and custom and classic cars too. No repair is too big or too small.
We offer same day service on most repairs, and we'll beat anyone's estimate while using original equipment parts. If getting to home or work is a problem while your car is with us, we can give you a free shuttle.
Customers tell us they appreciate Mike, Andrew and the team for clear communication and fair pricing. We're open Monday through Friday. Give us a call and we'll be happy to answer your questions.

## Services
- General auto repair: Everyday repairs and maintenance for your car or truck.
- Diesel and transmission repair: Transmissions are our specialty, and we work on diesel vehicles too, foreign or domestic.
- Custom and classic cars: We also work on custom and classic cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes. All repairs carry a warranty ranging from 1 year / 12,000 miles to 3 years / 36,000 miles.

Q: How do I get to work while my car is in the shop?
A: If you need it, we'll give you a free shuttle to your home or work.

Q: Can you fix my car the same day?
A: For most repairs, yes. We offer same day service on most repairs.
